trips.name: Nikko
trips.geocode_query: Nikko Toshogu Shrine, Nikko, Tochigi, Japan
trips.description: Take the Tobu Railway or JR limited express from Asakusa or Shinjuku to visit the lavishly decorated UNESCO World Heritage Toshogu Shrine and the surrounding forested temples.

trips.name: Kamakura
trips.geocode_query: Kotoku-in Great Buddha, Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan
trips.description: A seaside former samurai capital reached by JR Yokosuka Line, with the Great Buddha, Hasedera and Tsurugaoka Hachimangu shrine, plus the Enoden tram and beaches.

trips.name: Hakone
trips.description: Ride the Odakyu Romancecar from Shinjuku, then loop through the mountains by switchback train, cable car, ropeway and lake cruise for hot springs, volcanic Owakudani and views of Mt Fuji.
